cues: A breakfast cook peels a ripe tropical fruit and blends its soft flesh with yogurt for a smoothie.
A baker mashes sweet fruit into spiced batter, then bakes the mixture into a moist breakfast loaf.
A caterer slices tropical fruit into rounds and folds them into a chilled bowl with other produce.
A cook grills peeled fruit until caramelized, serving the warm slices beside rice and savory dishes.
A snack vendor tops cereal with soft fruit pieces, adding quick sweetness to a simple morning meal.
A food processor purees peeled tropical fruit with coconut milk to make a smooth chilled drink.
A grocer weighs ripe tropical fruit and portions it for shoppers assembling colorful fruit salads.
A pastry chef tucks sliced fruit beneath pastry, where baking softens it into a fragrant filling.
